seo.description: Evidence-based therapy for adults and teens near Kirkwood, MO. CBT, family therapy, and more — in-person and telehealth, about 18–20 minutes from downtown Kirkwood.

hero.headline: Therapy Near Kirkwood, Missouri
hero.intro: Kirkwood is a town built around its schools and its train station — Friday night football, a downtown you can actually walk, and a lot of families whose whole week revolves around kids' practices and games. We're about 18–20 minutes away, and for Kirkwood clients who'd rather not add a round trip to an already full week, telehealth covers most follow-up visits.

whyLocals.heading: Why Kirkwood Families Choose Us
whyLocals.paragraph: A lot of our Kirkwood clients are parents stretched thin between work and a kid's schedule, and teens for whom the pressure to perform — on a team, in a classroom, in a friend group — has started to show up as something more than stress. We treat both, and we coordinate therapy and psychiatric care under one roof when a family needs both.

treatmentSection.intro: Here's what treatment looks like, whether your first visit is in our office or over telehealth from your kitchen table in Kirkwood:

services.name: Cognitive Behavioral Therapy
services.description: The most evidence-supported approach for anxiety, depression, and the perfectionism that often shows up in competitive youth sports and academics.

services.name: Family Therapy
services.description: For families navigating a teen's struggles, a major transition, or a parent's substance use.

services.name: Motivational Interviewing
services.description: A collaborative approach for anyone who feels two ways about change — common with drinking or a teen's substance use.

services.name: Contingency Management
services.description: A structured, incentive-based approach with strong research support, especially for teens.

localFaqs.question: Can my Kirkwood teen be seen without missing school or practice?
localFaqs.answer: Usually, yes. We schedule around school and sports commitments where we can, and many families use telehealth for weeks when getting to the office isn't realistic between practice and homework.

localFaqs.question: Is telehealth as effective as an in-person visit for someone in Kirkwood?
localFaqs.answer: For most ongoing therapy and medication management, yes — research shows comparable outcomes. We recommend starting in person when possible so we can build rapport, then moving to a mix of in-person and telehealth as it makes sense for your schedule.

localFaqs.question: Do you treat substance use in Kirkwood teens specifically, not just adults?
localFaqs.answer: Yes. Contingency management and family therapy both have strong evidence for adolescent substance use, and we coordinate closely with parents throughout — while still protecting a teen's sense that therapy is a space that's theirs.
